formats.name: text_post
formats.notes: 3000 chars (secondary sources); mobile feed truncates after ~140-210 chars

formats.name: single_image
formats.notes: JPG/PNG/GIF; under 36,152,320 pixels; GIF up to 250 frames; no official MB cap found

formats.name: multi_image
formats.notes: organic only; up to 20 images per secondary source

formats.name: video
formats.notes: MP4; API doc says 3s-30min, 75KB-500MB spec table (API field max 5GB); UI organic cap reported 10-15 min (secondary); captions one SRT English only via API

formats.name: link_post
formats.notes: API requires title, description, thumbnail; no URL scraping via API

formats.name: poll
formats.notes: organic only via Posts API; option limits not verified

formats.name: article_long_form
formats.notes: title ~150 chars, body ~110000 chars from a single secondary source; no publishing API found

formats.name: live
formats.notes: application-based beta; H.264+AAC; max 30fps, 6 Mbps video, RTMP(S) ingest
